investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Cluster Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-08-05T12:54–13:02Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the agent pod because 2 nodes with kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity were fully exhausted and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected by any check, confirming the pod never reached a running state.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote agent pod on any of the 6 available cluster nodes. Two nodes that carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity (all VM slots consumed), and the remaining 4 nodes were excluded by the pod's node affinity or node selector rules. Preemption was also unavailable on both node groups. Because the pod remained unscheduled for ~142–144 seconds across all three checks, no VM was ever provisioned, and the eval runner received no evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState), causing every required-evidence assertion to fail. This is an eval-detected infrastructure scheduling constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-08-05T12:54–13:02Z with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes could not schedule the agent pod because 2 nodes with kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity were fully exhausted and the remaining 4 nodes did not match the pod's node affinity/selector. No evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected by any check, confirming the pod never reached a running state.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes scheduler could not place the remote agent pod on any of the 6 available cluster nodes. Two nodes that carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource reported insufficient capacity (all VM slots consumed), and the remaining 4 nodes were excluded by the pod's node affinity or node selector rules. Preemption was also unavailable on both node groups. Because the pod remained unscheduled for ~142–144 seconds across all three checks, no VM was ever provisioned, and the eval runner received no evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState), causing every required-evidence assertion to fail. This is an eval-detected infrastructure scheduling constraint, not a confirmed user-facing outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
